# Clear-ZbxPassiveProxyLog

## SYNOPSIS

Empties the log buffer of a running passive proxy session.

## SYNTAX

```
Clear-ZbxPassiveProxyLog [-Name] <string> [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Clear-ZbxPassiveProxyLog cmdlet deletes every entry the passive proxy session named in -Name keeps in its log buffer, so the next Get-ZbxPassiveProxyLog shows only what happens from now on. The listener keeps running and logging. -WhatIf shows which session it would clear. It writes nothing.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Start the log afresh

```powershell
Clear-ZbxPassiveProxyLog -Name 'dmz-proxy'
Get-ZbxPassiveProxyLog -Name 'dmz-proxy' | Select-Object Timestamp, Message
```

After the clear, the log holds only what the listener does next.

## PARAMETERS

### -Name

The session's name (the -Name it was started with).
